    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#2000; (* Catch Vac Ch2 Fault *)
ELSIF bTMR_CatchVac_Ch2_Healthy AND bTMR_CatchVac_Ch3_Healthy THEN
    rTMR_CatchVac_Voted := (rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_2 + rCatchCupVacuumPV_mbar_3) * 0.5;
    bTMR_CatchVac_Discrepancy := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#4000; (* Catch Vac Ch1 Fault *)
ELSE
    bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
    wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0040; (* Bit 6: Catch Vac TMR Complete Failure *)
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 3: THERMOPHYSICAL PROPERTIES & RAYLEIGH-PLATEAU HYDRODYNAMICS                *)
(* Rigorous evaluations of dynamic viscosity, surface tension, Weber & Ohnesorge numbers.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Dynamic temperature-dependent density: rho(T) = 6980 - 0.74 * (T - 231.9) [kg/m^3] *)
rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 6980.0 - 0.74 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - rTIN_MELTING_POINT_DEGC);
IF rTinDensity_kg_m3 < 6500.0 THEN
    rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 6500.0;
ELSIF rTinDensity_kg_m3 > 7200.0 THEN
    rTinDensity_kg_m3 := 7200.0;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic temperature-dependent surface tension: sigma(T) = 0.544 - 0.00007 * (T - 231.9) [N/m] *)
rTinSurfaceTension_N_m := 0.544 - 0.00007 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - rTIN_MELTING_POINT_DEGC);
IF rTinSurfaceTension_N_m < 0.450 THEN
    rTinSurfaceTension_N_m := 0.450;
END_IF;

(* Dynamic viscosity Arrhenius approximation: mu(T) = 0.00185 * (1.0 - 0.0015 * (T - 260.0)) [Pa*s] *)
rTinViscosity_Pa_s := 0.00185 * (1.0 - 0.0015 * (rTMR_TinTemp_Voted - 260.0));
IF rTinViscosity_Pa_s < 0.0012 THEN
    rTinViscosity_Pa_s := 0.0012;
END_IF;

(* Jet exit velocity from Torricelli / Bernoulli with capillary viscous loss: *)
(* v_jet = Cd * sqrt(2.0 * delta_P / rho) where delta_P in Pascals (1 bar = 1.0E5 Pa) *)
rAuxMathVar := (rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted * 1.0E5) - (rTMR_H2Press_Voted * 100.0);
IF rAuxMathVar > 0.0 THEN
    rJetVelocity_mps := rNOZZLE_DISCHARGE_COEFF * SQRT((2.0 * rAuxMathVar) / rTinDensity_kg_m3);
ELSE
    rJetVelocity_mps := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* Rayleigh-Plateau Capillary Instability Optimum Breakup Wavelength: lambda_opt = 4.508 * d_orifice *)
rOptimalWavelength_um := rRAYLEIGH_OPTIMAL_RATIO * rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM;

(* Hydrodynamic Natural Frequency: f_break = v_jet / lambda_opt *)
IF rOptimalWavelength_um > 1.0 THEN
    rTheoreticalBreakupFreq_kHz := (rJetVelocity_mps * 1.0E6) / (rOptimalWavelength_um * 1000.0);
ELSE
    rTheoreticalBreakupFreq_kHz := 50.0;
END_IF;

(* Weber Number: We = rho * v^2 * d / sigma *)
rWeberNumber := (rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rJetVelocity_mps * rJetVelocity_mps * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6))
                / rTinSurfaceTension_N_m;

(* Ohnesorge Number: Oh = mu / sqrt(rho * sigma * d) *)
rAuxMathVar := SQRT(rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rTinSurfaceTension_N_m * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6));
IF rAuxMathVar > 1.0E-9 THEN
    rOhnesorgeNumber := rTinViscosity_Pa_s / rAuxMathVar;
ELSE
    rOhnesorgeNumber := 0.015;
END_IF;

(* Reynolds Number: Re = rho * v * d / mu *)
IF rTinViscosity_Pa_s > 1.0E-6 THEN
    rReynoldsNumber := (rTinDensity_kg_m3 * rJetVelocity_mps * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6)) / rTinViscosity_Pa_s;
ELSE
    rReynoldsNumber := 1500.0;
END_IF;

(* Capillary Jet Continuous Breakup Length: L_break = v_jet * ln(R0/eps) / growth_rate *)
rBreakupDistance_mm := (12.0 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-3) * SQRT(MAX(1.0, rWeberNumber)));

(* Theoretical Droplet Diameter via Mass Conservation: D_drop = (1.5 * d^2 * lambda)^(1/3) *)
rAuxMathVar := 1.5 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM) * rOptimalWavelength_um;
rTheoreticalDropletDiameter_um := EXPT(rAuxMathVar, 0.33333333);

(* Total Stream Mass Flow Consumption Rate [mg/s] *)
rDropletMassFlow_mg_s := (rPI * 0.25 * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6) * (rNOZZLE_DIAMETER_NOMINAL_UM * 1.0E-6)
                         * rJetVelocity_mps * rTinDensity_kg_m3) * 1.0E6;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 4: DUAL-CAMERA STEREO SHADOWGRAPH & KALMAN FILTER STATE ESTIMATION           *)
(* Triangulates 3D position (X, Y, Z) and predicts arrival time at laser irradiation zone.  *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
IF bCamA_Valid AND bCamB_Valid THEN
    (* Stereo Sensor Fusion *)
    rFusedDropletX_um := rCamA_DropletX_um;
    rFusedDropletY_um := rCamB_DropletY_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := (rCamA_DropletZ_um + rCamB_DropletZ_um) * 0.5;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := (rCamA_Velocity_mps + rCamB_Velocity_mps) * 0.5;
ELSIF bCamA_Valid THEN
    rFusedDropletX_um := rCamA_DropletX_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := rCamA_DropletZ_um;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rCamA_Velocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0008; (* Camera B Strobe Lost *)
ELSIF bCamB_Valid THEN
    rFusedDropletY_um := rCamB_DropletY_um;
    rFusedDropletZ_um := rCamB_DropletZ_um;
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rCamB_Velocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics := wAlarmWord3_SensorDiagnostics OR 16#0080; (* Camera A Strobe Lost *)
ELSE
    (* Both Cameras Failed: Free-running Dead Reckoning *)
    rFusedVelocity_mps := rJetVelocity_mps;
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms OR 16#0001; (* Shadowgraph Stream Blind *)
END_IF;

(* Kalman State Propagation (Predict Step) *)
aKalmanState_Pred[0] := aKalmanState_Est[0] + (aKalmanState_Est[3] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[1] := aKalmanState_Est[1] + (aKalmanState_Est[4] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[2] := aKalmanState_Est[2] + (aKalmanState_Est[5] * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.0E6);
aKalmanState_Pred[3] := aKalmanState_Est[3];
aKalmanState_Pred[4] := aKalmanState_Est[4];
aKalmanState_Pred[5] := aKalmanState_Est[5];

(* Innovation / Measurement Residual: y = z - H * x_pred *)
aKalmanInnov[0] := rFusedDropletX_um - aKalmanState_Pred[0];
aKalmanInnov[1] := rFusedDropletY_um - aKalmanState_Pred[1];
aKalmanInnov[2] := rFusedVelocity_mps - aKalmanState_Pred[5];

(* Optimal Steady-State Kalman Gain Application *)
aKalmanGain_K[0, 0] := 0.65;    (* X position gain *)
aKalmanGain_K[1, 1] := 0.65;    (* Y position gain *)
aKalmanGain_K[2, 0] := 0.02;
aKalmanGain_K[3, 0] := 0.12;    (* Vx cross-correction from X residual *)
aKalmanGain_K[4, 1] := 0.12;    (* Vy cross-correction from Y residual *)
aKalmanGain_K[5, 2] := 0.58;    (* Vz axial velocity gain *)

(* State Vector Update Step: x_est = x_pred + K * innov *)
aKalmanState_Est[0] := aKalmanState_Pred[0] + (aKalmanGain_K[0, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[1] := aKalmanState_Pred[1] + (aKalmanGain_K[1, 1] * aKalmanInnov[1]);
aKalmanState_Est[2] := aKalmanState_Pred[2] + (aKalmanGain_K[2, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[3] := aKalmanState_Pred[3] + (aKalmanGain_K[3, 0] * aKalmanInnov[0]);
aKalmanState_Est[4] := aKalmanState_Pred[4] + (aKalmanGain_K[4, 1] * aKalmanInnov[1]);
aKalmanState_Est[5] := aKalmanState_Pred[5] + (aKalmanGain_K[5, 2] * aKalmanInnov[2]);

(* Predictive Droplet Arrival Timing at Laser Intermediate Focus Plane *)
IF aKalmanState_Est[5] > 20.0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := (rIRRADIATION_Z_DISTANCE_MM * 1.0E-3) - (aKalmanState_Est[2] * 1.0E-6);
    IF rAuxMathVar > 0.0 THEN
        rPredictedZArrival_ns := (rAuxMathVar / aKalmanState_Est[5]) * 1.0E9;
    ELSE
        rPredictedZArrival_ns := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rPredictedZArrival_ns := 1875000.0; (* Nominal 150mm @ 80m/s = 1.875 ms *)
END_IF;

(* Spatial & Temporal Jitter Statistical Rolling Buffer Evaluation *)
aJitterBuffer_X[iJitterBufferIndex] := aKalmanInnov[0];
aJitterBuffer_Y[iJitterBufferIndex] := aKalmanInnov[1];
aJitterBuffer_Time[iJitterBufferIndex] := (rPredictedZArrival_ns - 1875000.0) * 0.001;
iJitterBufferIndex := iJitterBufferIndex + 1;
IF iJitterBufferIndex >= 50 THEN
    iJitterBufferIndex := 0;
END_IF;

(* Compute 3-Sigma Variances across 50-sample sliding window *)
rSumSquareError_X := 0.0;
rSumSquareError_Y := 0.0;
rSumSquareError_Time := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 49 DO
    rSumSquareError_X := rSumSquareError_X + (aJitterBuffer_X[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_X[iLoopIndex_i]);
    rSumSquareError_Y := rSumSquareError_Y + (aJitterBuffer_Y[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_Y[iLoopIndex_i]);
    rSumSquareError_Time := rSumSquareError_Time + (aJitterBuffer_Time[iLoopIndex_i] * aJitterBuffer_Time[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;
rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um := 3.0 * SQRT(rSumSquareError_X * 0.02 + rSumSquareError_Y * 0.02);
rDropletTimingJitter3Sigma_ns := 3.0 * SQRT(rSumSquareError_Time * 0.02);

(* Trajectory Jitter Safety Interlock *)
IF (rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um > 2.8) AND (iOperationalState >= 70) THEN
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms OR 16#0002; (* High Spatial Jitter Warning *)
    IF rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um > 4.5 THEN
        bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0080; (* Critical Trajectory Divergence Trip *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 5: MODEL PREDICTIVE CONTROL (MPC) QUADRATIC COST OPTIMIZATION                 *)
(* Receding horizon gradient step to minimize position drift, pressure variance & jitter.    *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* State Tracking Error Vector Assembly *)
aStateVector_x[0] := aKalmanState_Est[0] - rLaserFocalPointX_um;
aStateVector_x[1] := aKalmanState_Est[1] - rLaserFocalPointY_um;
aStateVector_x[2] := aKalmanState_Est[2] - (rIRRADIATION_Z_DISTANCE_MM * 1000.0);
aStateVector_x[3] := aKalmanState_Est[3];
aStateVector_x[4] := aKalmanState_Est[4];
aStateVector_x[5] := aKalmanState_Est[5] - rDropletVelocitySetpoint_mps;
aStateVector_x[6] := rTMR_ArgonPress_Voted - rArgonPressureSP_bar;
aStateVector_x[7] := rTMR_H2Press_Voted - 1.50;

(* Evaluate Quadratic Cost Function: J = x^T * Q * x + u^T * R * u + du^T * S * du *)
rMPC_Cost_J := 0.0;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 7 DO
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_Q[iLoopIndex_i] * aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;
FOR iLoopIndex_i := 0 TO 3 DO
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_R[iLoopIndex_i] * aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i]);
    aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i] := aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_i] - aControlVector_u_prev[iLoopIndex_i];
    rMPC_Cost_J := rMPC_Cost_J + (aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i] * aMPC_Weight_S[iLoopIndex_i] * aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_i]);
END_FOR;

(* Compute Quadratic Cost Gradient wrt Control Vector: grad_u = 2 * (B^T * Q * x + R * u + S * du) *)
FOR iLoopIndex_k := 0 TO 3 DO
    rTempSum := 0.0;
    FOR iLoopIndex_j := 0 TO 7 DO
        rTempSum := rTempSum + (aMatrix_B[iLoopIndex_j, iLoopIndex_k] * aMPC_Weight_Q[iLoopIndex_j] * aStateVector_x[iLoopIndex_j]);
    END_FOR;
    aMPC_Grad[iLoopIndex_k] := rTempSum + (aMPC_Weight_R[iLoopIndex_k] * aControlVector_u[iLoopIndex_k])
                               + (aMPC_Weight_S[iLoopIndex_k] * aDeltaControl_du[iLoopIndex_k]);
END_FOR;

(* Constrained Newton-Raphson Gradient Descent Step: u_k = u_{k-1} - H_inv * grad *)
(* Input 0: Fine Piezo Frequency Tuning Command [kHz] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[0] := aControlVector_u[0];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[0] * aMPC_Grad[0]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u0;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[0] := aControlVector_u[0] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[0] > 5.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[0] := 5.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[0] < -5.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[0] := -5.0;
END_IF;

(* Input 1: Dynamic Piezo Drive Voltage [V] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[1] := aControlVector_u[1];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[1] * aMPC_Grad[1]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u1;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[1] := aControlVector_u[1] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[1] > 95.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[1] := 95.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[1] < 15.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[1] := 15.0;
END_IF;

(* Input 2: Argon Propellant Back-Pressure Setpoint [bar] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[2] := aControlVector_u[2];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[2] * aMPC_Grad[2]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u2;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[2] := aControlVector_u[2] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[2] > 135.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[2] := 135.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[2] < 55.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[2] := 55.0;
END_IF;

(* Input 3: Hydrogen Curtain Mass Flow Command [sccm] *)
aControlVector_u_prev[3] := aControlVector_u[3];
rAuxMathVar := - (aMPC_Hessian_Inv[3] * aMPC_Grad[3]);
IF rAuxMathVar > rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u3 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u3;
ELSIF rAuxMathVar < -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u3 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := -rMPC_SlewRateLimit_u3;
END_IF;
aControlVector_u[3] := aControlVector_u[3] + rAuxMathVar;
IF aControlVector_u[3] > 1800.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[3] := 1800.0;
ELSIF aControlVector_u[3] < 200.0 THEN
    aControlVector_u[3] := 200.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 6: DUAL-PULSE LASER SYNCHRONIZATION & PIEZO-GALVO BEAM STEERING               *)
(* Hydrodynamic pancake expansion modeling and nanosecond trigger delay calculation.       *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Optimal inter-pulse separation for maximum 10.6um CO2 laser absorption: *)
(* t_interpulse = (d_pancake_opt - d_0) / (2.0 * v_radial) *)
rAuxMathVar := (rPancakeTargetDiameter_um - rTheoreticalDropletDiameter_um) * 1.0E-6;
IF rPancakeExpansionVelocity_mps > 10.0 THEN
    rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns := (rAuxMathVar / (2.0 * rPancakeExpansionVelocity_mps)) * 1.0E9;
ELSE
    rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns := 2400.0;
END_IF;

(* Clamp inter-pulse delay to safe physical envelope (1800ns to 3200ns) *)
IF rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns > 3200.0 THEN
    rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns := 3200.0;
ELSIF rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns < 1800.0 THEN
    rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns := 1800.0;
END_IF;
rMainPulseInterPulseDelay_ns := rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns;

(* Pre-Pulse Laser Q-switch Trigger Timing Alignment *)
(* Phase delay relative to 50 kHz master period T = 20,000 ns *)
rAuxMathVar := rPredictedZArrival_ns - (TRUNC(rPredictedZArrival_ns / 20000.0) * 20000.0);
IF rAuxMathVar < 0.0 THEN
    rAuxMathVar := rAuxMathVar + 20000.0;
END_IF;
rPrePulseTriggerDelay_ns := rAuxMathVar;

(* Telecentric Fast Steering Mirror (Galvo) Deflection Commands: *)
(* theta = atan(delta_pos / focal_length) approx delta_pos [um] / F [mm] in [urad] *)
rAuxMathVar := (aKalmanState_Est[0] - rLaserFocalPointX_um) * (1000.0 / rFOCAL_LENGTH_GALVO_MM);
(* Apply Notch Filter for Galvo Structural Resonance Suppression *)
rGalvoFilteredX := (rGalvoNotchDampingCoeff * rGalvoFilteredX) + ((1.0 - rGalvoNotchDampingCoeff) * rAuxMathVar);
rGalvoSteerX_urad := rGalvoFilteredX;

rAuxMathVar := (aKalmanState_Est[1] - rLaserFocalPointY_um) * (1000.0 / rFOCAL_LENGTH_GALVO_MM);
rGalvoFilteredY := (rGalvoNotchDampingCoeff * rGalvoFilteredY) + ((1.0 - rGalvoNotchDampingCoeff) * rAuxMathVar);
rGalvoSteerY_urad := rGalvoFilteredY;

(* Galvo Travel Envelope Protection Interlock (+/- 150 urad maximum travel) *)
IF (ABS(rGalvoSteerX_urad) > 140.0) OR (ABS(rGalvoSteerY_urad) > 140.0) THEN
    wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms := wAlarmWord2_ProcessAlarms OR 16#0004; (* Galvo Approaching Stroke Limit *)
    IF (ABS(rGalvoSteerX_urad) > 180.0) OR (ABS(rGalvoSteerY_urad) > 180.0) THEN
        bCriticalTripLatched := TRUE;
        wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips := wAlarmWord1_CriticalTrips OR 16#0100; (* Galvo Mechanical Over-travel *)
    END_IF;
END_IF;

(* Real-time EUV In-band Conversion Efficiency (CE) Estimation *)
rAuxMathVar := rPrePulseLaserEnergy_mJ + rMainPulseLaserEnergy_mJ;
IF (rAuxMathVar > 50.0) AND (iOperationalState = 80) THEN
    rEUVConversionEfficiency_pct := (3.85 * (1.0 - (rDropletPositionJitter3Sigma_um / 10.0)))
                                   * (1.0 - (ABS(rOptimalInterPulseDelay_ns - 2400.0) / 4000.0));
    IF rEUVConversionEfficiency_pct < 0.0 THEN
        rEUVConversionEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
    END_IF;
ELSE
    rEUVConversionEfficiency_pct := 0.0;
END_IF;

(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* SUB-ROUTINE 7: DEBRIS MITIGATION HYDROGEN CURTAIN & CATCH CUP VACUUM SIPHONING             *)
(* Fast ion stopping power calculations, chemical stannane kinetics and vacuum drainage.     *)
(* ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- *)
(* Hydrogen Gas Curtain Density in Vacuum Chamber [kg/m^3]: *)
rH2BufferGasDensity_kg_m3 := (rTMR_H2Press_Voted * 100.0) / (4124.0 * (25.0 + 273.15));

(* Fast Ion Stopping Mean Free Path [mm]: lambda_mfp = 1 / (n * sigma_coll) *)
IF rTMR_H2Press_Voted > 0.1 THEN
    rFastIonMeanFreePath_mm := 18.6 / rTMR_H2Press_Voted;
ELSE
    rFastIonMeanFreePath_mm := 186.0;
END_IF;

(* Chemical Stannane Formation Rate: Sn(s) + 4 H* -> SnH4(g) [mol/s] *)
rStannaneReactionRate_mol_s := 1.25E-6 * (rTMR_H2Press_Voted / 1.50) * (rEUVConversionEfficiency_pct / 3.5);

(* Hydrogen Curtain Closed-Loop Flow Setpoint Generation *)
rH2_PID_IntegralAccum := rH2_PID_IntegralAccum + ((1.50 - rTMR_H2Press_Voted) * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 12.0);
IF rH2_PID_IntegralAccum > 1500.0 THEN
    rH2_PID_IntegralAccum := 1500.0;
ELSIF rH2_PID_IntegralAccum < 100.0 THEN
    rH2_PID_IntegralAccum := 100.0;
END_IF;
rH2CurtainMassFlowSP_sccm := aControlVector_u[3] + rH2_PID_IntegralAccum;

(* Catch Cup Siphon Differential Vacuum Pump Speed Control *)
rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum := rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum + ((0.80 - rTMR_CatchVac_Voted) * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 850.0);
IF rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum > 4500.0 THEN
    rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum := 4500.0;
ELSIF rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum < 500.0 THEN
    rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum := 500.0;
END_IF;
rCatchCupSiphonPumpSP_rpm := rCatchVac_PID_IntegralAccum;

(* Catch Cup Anti-Freeze Heating Loop *)
IF rCatchCupTempPV_degC < 245.0 THEN
    bCatchCupHeaterEnable := TRUE;
ELSE
    bCatchCupHeaterEnable := FALSE;
END_IF;

(* Tin Reservoir Closed-Loop Temperature PID Duty Cycle *)
rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum := rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum + ((260.0 - rTMR_TinTemp_Voted) * rCYCLE_TIME_SEC * 1.5);
IF rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum > 100.0 THEN
    rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum := 100.0;
ELSIF rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum < 0.0 THEN
    rTinTemp_PID_IntegralAccum := 0.0;
